notes: Paramount principle: safety, health, and welfare of public and fellow workers. Addresses conflicts of interest, professional reputation, fair competition, and continuous development. Enforcement via member conduct mechanisms.

Binds member organizations (not individuals) to transparency, safety culture, prevention of illicit nuclear material use, and compliance with IAEA Safety Standards. All companies must agree upon joining WNA.

document_title: Establishing a Code of Ethics for Nuclear Professionals (Nuclear Energy Series guidance)
notes: IAEA guidance publication (Nuclear Energy Series) providing a framework for national nuclear organizations to develop their own codes of ethics. Not itself an enforceable code but a standard-setting document.

AGA is a trade group, not a professional association for individuals. Ethics-adjacent document is the Antitrust Compliance Program. No formal member code of ethics for individual professionals was found. Note: 'AGA Code of Ethics' search results often confusingly return the Association of Government Accountants (different organization).
